method: Three alternating fresh-process pairs per host for full compiled and N=10000 reference. Array-compiled uses the SAME new source on old/new runtimes at N=10000. Full new reference is one sample per host; no full old reference timing. Mac post-proof is one full compiled repeat. Node v24.15.0; parse/analysis/execution included, startup excluded, process-lifetime peak RSS. Intel requires >=98% idle and no active swap before samples; foreign Node jobs checked before/every second. All accepted samples retained, interrupted series resumes matching prefix.
limitations: Reference peak RSS increases significantly; this is not a universal memory optimization.
No full original reference speedup claimed. N=10000 is a separately labelled paired workload.
The Mac stream-purity guard was narrowed after the main series; N=1000 generated kernel hashes remained identical and a full post-proof compiled control is included. Intel samples use final guard.
2322 broad checks in 78 files per host, plus one final RHS-effect-order check in an 86-check rerun per host. Exhaustive audits not run.
Manual JavaScript controls omit language parsing, validation, alias/snapshot and replay guarantees. They are single diagnostic samples.
A preliminary contaminated Intel run was discarded before the final accepted series. Unrelated services were not stopped.
